title: ASSIGN BACKGROUND
description: Establish where the character comes from, the communities that shaped them, and the social and personal circumstances they bring into play.

substeps.title: Assign Starting Region & Settlement
substeps.description: Choose the character's starting region and settlement.

substeps.title: Assign Demographics
substeps.description: Establish demographic details used by later background and biological choices.

substeps.title: Assign Heritage
substeps.description: Choose cultural, environmental, and societal heritage packages.

substeps.title: Assign Social Rank
substeps.description: Determine the character's social standing and related background effects.

substeps.title: Assign Personality
substeps.description: Record the personality traits that define the character's behavioral cues.

substeps.title: Assign Tragedy Seed
substeps.description: Choose or generate a tragedy seed for the character's personal history.

substeps.title: Assign Disabilities
substeps.description: Record applicable disabilities and their rules effects.

substeps.title: Assign Belief & Worship
substeps.description: Choose belief, worship, and deity relationships where applicable.

title: ASSIGN INTRINSICS
description: Define the character's species, core attributes, profession, magic potential, and starting wealth.

substeps.title: Assign Sophont Species
substeps.description: Choose the Sophont species and lineage that establish biological adjustments and constraints.

substeps.title: Assign Attributes
substeps.description: Generate or purchase the character's attributes and apply sourced adjustments.

substeps.title: Assign Trade and Specialization
substeps.description: Choose Trade, specialization, and starting professional rank.

substeps.title: Assign Zed
substeps.description: Assign ZED using the DXD character-creation rules.

substeps.title: Assign Wealth
substeps.description: Determine Wealth Rank and starting economic resources.

title: ASSIGN PROFICIENCIES
description: Establish PML and the learned capabilities the character brings into play.

substeps.title: Assign PML
substeps.description: Set starting Piconit Metastasis Level and apply its creation effects.

substeps.title: Assign Skills, Abilities, and Talents
substeps.description: Apply package-granted capabilities and make the player's proficiency selections.

substeps.title: Assign Additional Skills
substeps.description: Spend remaining character-creation skill resources.

substeps.title: Assign Languages
substeps.description: Assign languages and fluency levels from background and purchased choices.

title: ASSIGN PROPERTIES
description: Resolve physical dimensions and the derived values that follow from completed character choices.

substeps.title: Assign Height and Weight
substeps.description: Determine physical height and weight from species, SIZ, age, and applicable adjustments.

substeps.title: Assign Calculations
substeps.description: Calculate derived performance, combat, mana, carrying, and other character values.

title: ASSIGN UTILITIES
description: Finish the character with spells, equipment, magic items, identity, and relationships.

substeps.title: Assign Spells
substeps.description: Choose starting spells when the character has access to spellcasting.

substeps.title: Assign Starting Gear
substeps.description: Choose weapons, armor, equipment, and other starting possessions.

substeps.title: Assign Magic Items
substeps.description: Assign starting magic items when granted or purchased.

substeps.title: Assign Name
substeps.description: Record the character's name and naming details.

substeps.title: Assign Relationships
substeps.description: Record the important relationships that connect the character to people and organizations.
